editorial:
Imagine being so broke that you have to take a job you are totally unqualified for. That is exactly where you find yourself when you meet the main character, a newbie hitman who is struggling to make ends meet. He gets thrown into a wild situation where he has to track down a killer targeting a wealthy Japanese tycoon. The vibe is a crazy mix of high-stakes tension and goofy humor, making it feel less like a dark crime drama and more like a fun ride. You will love how the movie balances the scary parts of the underworld with moments that just make you laugh at how messy everything is.

The action scenes are the real highlight here, with fast fights and clever twists that keep you guessing. While some of the acting is a bit over the top, it actually fits the quirky style of the film. The pacing stays quick, so you never feel bored. If you enjoy old-school action flicks, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head in a big showdown where the real mastermind is finally revealed. After a series of fights, the rookie hitman manages to outsmart the professionals and save the tycoon. He proves he is more than just a beginner by using his wits instead of just a gun. The movie wraps up with him getting paid and finding some peace, showing that he finally found his footing in a dangerous world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s action movies with a side of comedy.
